task: Present audit processing as an accessible modal over the existing page and update the local Docker review container.
nonGoals: Backend progress, scoring, password or usage changes; merging or public Cloudflare deployment.

outcomes.description: Existing page remains visible behind a modal loading dialog throughout submission and polling; native modal focus containment, Escape cancellation, scroll lock and mobile scrolling work.
outcomes.evidence: Updated SSR expectations and browser modal interactions.

outcomes.description: Terminal results close the dialog and display the report; cancel/error/timeout/auth expiry remain correct. Local container serves reviewed simulated flow without real audits.
outcomes.evidence: Browser fixture proof and local Docker verification.

process.description: Commit this changed requirement as a new plan before implementation; independent review and updated source-bound records for both plans, then rerun PR CI.
process.evidence: Git history, evaluator record and CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse existing loading content and native dialog behavior; no new dependencies, public deployments or model calls.

exitTest.reason: Application modal presentation only; no agent workflow, portability, memory or resumability change. Existing exit smoke tests remain required.
